#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
task_root=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listitemid-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin
cd "$task_root" || exit 1
task_raw=build/listitemid-native
# Wait only for this owned driver's completed phase marker; failure leaves
# contracts pending, never manufactures a passing result.
task_deadline=$((SECONDS + 7200))
until test -f "$task_raw/fixed-after-clang.log"; do
 test "$SECONDS" -lt "$task_deadline" || exit 124
 sleep 30
done
for task_compiler in gcc clang; do
 test "$(<"$task_raw/fixed-$task_compiler.status")" = 0 || exit 2
 test "$(<"$task_raw/preservation-$task_compiler.status")" = 0 || exit 3
 sha256sum -c "$task_raw/fixed-$task_compiler.log.sha256" || exit 4
done
sha256sum -c "$task_raw/fixed.sha256" > "$task_raw/contracts-inputs-before.log" || exit 5
export TMPDIR="$task_root/build/listitemid-tmp"
export COPPERFIN_LOCALE_DIR="$task_root/resources/locales"
nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 ctest --test-dir build/listitemid-gcc -V --output-on-failure --timeout 600 -j 1 -R '^(test_contributor_signoff_contract|test_changelog_fragment_assembler|test_changelog_fragments_valid|test_agent_channel_contract|test_safety_traceability_workflow_contract)$' > "$task_raw/contracts.log" 2>&1
task_status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/contracts.status"
date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > "$task_raw/contracts.completed-at"
sha256sum "$task_raw/contracts.log" > "$task_raw/contracts.log.sha256"
sha256sum -c "$task_raw/fixed.sha256" > "$task_raw/contracts-inputs-after.log" || exit 5
exit "$task_status"
